filesystem.detail: Three restores retained source hashes, prepared marker, permissions and symlink, plus installed dependencies without another npm ci.

processes.detail: Source nonce/PID survived capture; each memory fork retained the listener, nonce and PID. Its inherited server was stopped, then explicitly restarted with a distinct nonce for patch verification.

isolation.detail: After all controls finished, each branch retained its expected patched hashes and a distinct marker; the source marker stayed absent and its tracked files stayed unchanged.

jobReattachment.detail: An E2B SDK command stream disconnected after initial output; a new SDK client reconnected to the same sandbox and command PID. It recovered exit 0 and durable guest stdout, then read the remaining bytes from the saved offset. This is not server-side SSE cursor replay or dashboard reconnection.

previewRevocation.detail: API sandbox absence and preview HTTP observations are recorded separately.
